simple.meaning: שֹׁמְרוֹן (Shômᵉrôwn) appears 109 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Nehemiah, Isaiah, and 3 more, beginning at 1 Kings 13:32. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, altar, kingship, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֹׁמְרוֹן (H8111) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שֹׁמְרוֹן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
